audience: fundraisers at nonprofits who collect online donations and run events with Qgiv

useCases.title: Add up donations for a date range
useCases.text: The AI lists transactions between two dates (31 days at most per call) with amount, fee, net, fund and form. It totals them for you.

useCases.title: Check refunds and their size
useCases.text: The AI lists refunds by date range or the most recent ones, with the original transaction, amount and fund, and reads one refund in full.

useCases.title: Review recurring gift schedules
useCases.text: The AI lists recurring schedules filtered by active, paused, expired or deleted, with next billing date, frequency, amount and the 12-month forecast.

useCases.title: See peer-to-peer registrations and amounts raised
useCases.text: The AI lists peer-to-peer registrations with team, fundraising goal and amount raised, and reads one in full. You see who is close to a goal.

useCases.title: Check monthly fee and payout statements
useCases.text: The AI lists statements with amount contributed, fees, refunded and debited, and reads one with its transaction rows.

useCases.title: List your events with packages and promo codes
useCases.text: The AI lists ticketed and auction events with dates and settings, and with details it also shows packages, questions and promo codes.
